shots.seen: Full cartoon bedroom reads well: window with moon and curtains, fan, 3:07 clock, nani photo, calendar, door with light strip. But both faces on the pillows sit exactly under the caption bar, so the subject is hidden.
problems: focal slightly low: subject not dominant
shots.fix: Raise the bed so the heads sit at ~60% height above the caption band, enlarge the kid, add a warm rim/glow from the door on the kid so the face is the brightest busy area.

shots.seen: Door close-up with panels, brass handle and a strong warm strip; two long foot shadows appear on the floor. Left half of the wall and the lower floor are bare purple areas; clock is cropped at the top edge.
shots.fix: Reframe slightly lower so the clock leaves the frame cleanly; add a switchboard and a hanging school bag on the left wall, a pair of slippers and a rug on the floor in the light spill.

shots.seen: Camera lands on the headboard and blanket; the kid's face is half off the left edge and behind the caption; mother's hair is the clearest shape. No readable scared expression.
shots.fix: Frame on the kid's head position directly (computed from the bed rig) and place it at upper-centre of the screen; bigger head scale, blanket to chin with stitched pattern, tear/sweat drop, door glow behind as a warm rim.
